findings.impact: The Markdown report and committed progress receipt classify independent review as NOT_RUN, while the JSON manifest records ROUND_1_NOT_CLEAN and four schema-valid NOT_CLEAN review artifacts are committed. This understates an observed failed review round and makes the report/JSON verification status inconsistent.
findings.minimal_fix: Update the Markdown report and progress receipt to record ROUND_1_NOT_CLEAN, identify the four committed review results, and state that corrections await re-review.

findings.impact: The durable issue/Discord receipt binds the report and manifest as published at commit 7a9999f, with hashes b58ec3... and 1fc8c2..., but both artifacts were subsequently corrected in bc560f4 and now hash to 391a4f... and c53d11.... There is no committed evidence that the corrected HEAD artifacts were added to the GitHub issue or delivered to Luke, so delivery does not cover the current report identity.
findings.minimal_fix: Update the GitHub issue and resend the corrected HEAD report and manifest, then commit a receipt containing their current commit, byte counts, SHA-256 hashes, issue-comment identifier, and Discord message identifier.
